title: When the Playlist Burns
author: Odile Thornbury
blurb: Casper Zhou, the eldest sibling raising the younger ones while mom works nights, is fine. Everything is fine. Obviously.. But when the college essay prompt asks one honest question nobody can stop answering, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must expose what the school board buried before the final audition.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
